# tuannx/maven

Personal fork. Do not open pull requests or comments on apache/maven. Do not create tags or releases.

| path | role |
|---|---|
| [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md) | coding-agent contract: build, principles, rubric, ADR rule |
| [docs/adr/](docs/adr/template.md) | ADR-0001..0012, [ADR-0016](docs/adr/0016-warm-build-cache-without-committing.md), [boundaries.yml](docs/adr/boundaries.yml), and the template |
| [docs/agents/rubric-gate.md](docs/agents/rubric-gate.md) | rubric-gate skill |
| [docs/agents/write-adr.md](docs/agents/write-adr.md) | write-adr skill |
| [docs/agents/fast-maven-loop.md](docs/agents/fast-maven-loop.md) | fast-maven-loop skill |
| [.github/actions/build-speedup-bench/llms.txt](.github/actions/build-speedup-bench/llms.txt) | bench action contract |
| [.github/actions/rubric-gate/llms.txt](.github/actions/rubric-gate/llms.txt) | rubric-gate action contract |

Cursor loads the same three skills from `.cursor/skills/`.

## Bench snippet

`v1` is a moving tag a human cuts on master after merge. Pin a commit SHA until that tag exists. This fork does not create it.

```yaml
permissions:
  contents: read

steps:
  - uses: actions/checkout@v7
  - uses: tuannx/maven/.github/actions/build-speedup-bench@v1
    with:
      pom: pom.xml
```

Dogfood: `uses: ./.github/actions/build-speedup-bench`, `pom: api/pom.xml`, `upload-logs: true`. `actions: write` on that workflow is only for step `Upload timing logs`. Check name: `build-speedup-bench`.

## Rubric snippet

Report-only. Default token is `contents: read`. Jobs that upload a JSON result add `actions: write` for that upload step.

```yaml
permissions:
  contents: read

steps:
  - uses: actions/checkout@v7
  - uses: tuannx/maven/.github/actions/rubric-gate@v0
    with:
      command: all
      base: origin/master
```

`v0` is not a tag yet. Dogfood uses `uses: ./.github/actions/rubric-gate`. Check name: `rubric-gate`.
